Asset type: DFU record084 angry eye atlas, raw upper-half source for pixel-art portrait animation
Input image: Image 1 is the prepared eyes reference grid and exact edit target. It shows four identical enlarged original upper portrait halves.
Primary request: Edit this full 2×2 grid into an angry eye atlas. Preserve four cell boundaries, crop, scale, face, hair, and background. Add tense lowered inner brows and focused narrowed eyes. Cell order: top-left open; top-right half-closed blink; bottom-left fully closed blink; bottom-right repeat-open. Open cells match. During blinking, lids cover the same eyeballs vertically. Keep the brown irises the original size, same width and horizontal position in every phase; lids occlude them. Fully closed lids hide irises. Add no white pixels or bright flashes.
Style: original muted brown skin, small brown irises, golden wavy hair, soft low-contrast DOS-era pixel clusters. Preserve exact portrait identity and native pixel scale within each enlarged cell.
Constraints: modify eyes and brows only. Keep nose, cheeks, hair, face outline, lighting, background, crop, original framing and 2×2 grid unchanged. Keep brows in original area around native y12..17 of each upper half; do not raise eyes or brows. No thick black strokes, oversized round irises, extra highlights, white blink pixels, or changed face.
